'''Maniac''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Krish (species)/Legends|Krish]], who worked as a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Maniac originally worked for the [[Yagaran Four]], a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. When they insisted that he modify the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] on their [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]], Maniac agreed, but pushed the hyperdrive right to the edge of its capabilities with some new modifications. As a result, when the bounty hunters engaged the hyperdrive near the world [[Elin Roe]], their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] exploded.

Afterward, Maniac gained employment as a [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] in [[Bolabo's Garage]] on [[Byblos/Legends|Byblos]]. While working there, he modified the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-X0]] and nicknamed it "Patchwork."

==Personality and traits==
Maniac had a maniacal look in his eyes, a pointy-toothed grin and continually giggled uncontrollably. His hobby was modifying droids and he also liked to try and solve small electronic puzzles. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] considered Maniac to be creepy.
